title: Pre-rotation key lifecycle event (SIGN-PREROT-1)
description: One signed event in an identity's key-history chain, as produced by hub/key-lifecycle.mjs. 'inception' is self-signed by the genesis key and commits SHA-256(next public key). 'rotation' reveals the pre-committed key, is signed BY that revealed key, commits SHA-256(the NEW next key), and links to the prior event by prev_event_digest. Continuity from any earlier event to the current key is verified by walking this chain (hub/key-lifecycle.mjs verifyKeyLineage / ui/lib/verify-key-lineage.mjs offline mirror) and checking, at each link, that the revealed key hashes to the prior event's commitment and validly signs the rotation. SHA-256 + Ed25519 only — no digest or signature-algorithm agility (phil GO, SIGNING-SURFACES-BUILD-SPEC.md §2).

payload.description: base64 of the JCS-canonicalized event object (see $defs/inceptionPayload, $defs/rotationPayload) — decode-then-validate against the matching $def by key_event.

signatures.description: inception: exactly one entry, label "self". rotation: one entry label "revealed" (MUST, the whole continuity proof) plus an OPTIONAL second entry label "outgoing" (the retiring key co-signing while still valid).
